# Quick verification that condition parameter works
import threading
from cachetools import cached, LRUCache, cachedmethod

call_count = 0

@cached(cache=LRUCache(10), condition=threading.Condition())
def slow_func(x):
    global call_count
    call_count += 1
    return x * 2

# Basic test
assert slow_func(5) == 10
assert slow_func(5) == 10  # should be cached
assert call_count == 1  # only called once

# Test without condition still works
@cached(cache=LRUCache(10))
def normal_func(x):
    return x * 3

assert normal_func(5) == 15
assert normal_func(5) == 15

print("m1 basic tests passed!")
